info.name: SSG Web API - Implemented Endpoints
info.description: Implemented public catalogue/product endpoints, search (113), guest enquiries (116/117), admin catalogue reads (134/135), and catalogue import preflight (138). Set baseUrl and frontendOrigin. Run guest bootstrap first for enquiries; it saves guestCsrfToken and sets a Secure cookie, requiring HTTPS outside supported localhost clients. Preserve enquiryRequestId and the exact payload on retries; regenerate it only for an intentional new submission. Email notifications use durable private dev capture, not real delivery. Admin drafts do not require published stock/media. Dev staff authentication requires explicit opt-in, two 32+ character secrets and appropriate live staff permissions; it is rejected in production. Import accepts nested product JSON with backend-generated SSG IDs, not XLSX uploads; public endpoints exclude drafts.

request.description: Checks API and database connectivity. configuration_ready is false until shop settings are configured.

Returns a CSRF token and expiry, and sets an HttpOnly Secure session cookie. The Origin must match a configured CORS_ORIGINS value. Keep the cookie in Postman's cookie jar for subsequent protected requests.
Localized literal substring search. Independent groups contain items/total/page/page_size. Empty q returns empty groups; unknown query fields are rejected.

request.description: Bootstrap a guest first and retain its Secure cookie. Requires server-configured coordinatorEmail. Returns 201/new or 200/same-payload replay; changed payload with the same request ID returns 409. Callback/similar requests require international phone; similar also requires published jewellery product context. Notifications are queued for private dev capture, not real email delivery.
Use the same guest and original request ID after a timeout. Returns only received/reference or unknown_result. Does not resubmit, send mail or reveal other guests' data.
Returns all public dictionary groups in the requested locale.
Repeated groups parameters select a subset of public dictionaries.
Resolves a current product route or redirects a previous route. Requires a matching published route and PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN configuration; unknown routes return 404.

Requires a published product, requested locale translation, current route and approved media. Set fulfilment_method and its matching locality_id or pickup_location_code together when testing a destination context. A missing product returns 404; required public URL/media configuration must be supplied.
Optional delivery-context example. Replace localityId with a configured locality identifier; locality directory configuration is not currently seeded.
Lists published products. Returns an empty 200 response when no products are published.
Example filtered and sorted catalogue request. Optional supported filters include jewellery_type, selection_id, repeated material_codes/gemstone_codes, price_min/price_max, and fulfilment context.
Returns one ordered result per unique requested UUID. Unknown or unpublished IDs receive a generic unavailable entry. Maximum 50 IDs.

Requires the configured development staff token pair and allowed Origin; no database permission grant. Supports optional q (SSG ID or BG/EN draft/current title), publication_status (draft/published/hidden), page and page_size (1..100). Omit publication_status to list all states. Response: items, total, page, page_size. Draft names take precedence over current published names. Copy an item UUID into productId for the detail request. Response is private, no-store.

Requires the configured development staff token pair and allowed Origin; no database permission grant. Returns AdminProduct: draft and matching draft_revision_id (both nullable), published_revision_id, slug_preview, verified units, deduplicated staged_unit_count and actionable validation_errors. No query parameters. Does not create drafts, publish, activate media or promote staged units. Validation errors are read-time checks, not a successful byte-verified publication preflight. Missing UUID returns 404; malformed UUID/unknown query returns 400.

item.name: Upload and append media to draft (development only)

request.description: Select a real JPEG/PNG/WebP file (longest side >=1600px; <=10MiB). Let Postman generate multipart Content-Type. Uses S3 eu-central-1; requires DEV_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED and configured bucket credentials plus MEDIA_CDN_BASE_URL. Generates measured square WebP derivatives and appends to draft; does not publish. Copy returned version/draft UUID before publishing. When appending to an existing main image, use a different client_key, non-main role and sort_order greater than existing maximum. Supports <=5 new files, <=50 total selected images. Match each binary field image_<client_key> to metadata. Same request/bytes replay; changed payload409. S3 policies must keep private/products originals private.

Set productVersion and draftRevisionId from the current admin detail response. Requires explicit DEV_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true, valid public site/CDN configuration, the configured development staff token pair and allowed Origin, and approved media already registered and attached. No database permission grant. Does not upload/register/approve/attach media or inspect actual files. Development metadata-only publication is rejected in production. Image-less drafts fail MEDIA_NOT_READY. Reuse publishRequestId and the exact payload on retries; changed payload returns 409. Archive exits additionally require confirm_archive_exit:true and a reviewed draft reason/note. Success200 returns AdminProduct with draft consumed and published_revision_id set.

item.name: Catalogue import
item.description: Use local-media-import.example.json for product preflight and commit. New imports omit images; attach files using Catalogue publication / Upload and append media to draft, then publish explicitly. Previously staged image batches remain committable.

request.description: Requires the configured development staff token pair and allowed Origin; no database permission grant. New imports use data.products with units/materials/legacy_links nested in each product; all three arrays are required even when empty. Omit images and attach files separately after commit. Do not send ssg_id anywhere or sibling sheet arrays. Backend-generated SSG-XXXXXXXX IDs are returned in products in input order; retain them and batch_id for commit with version:null. Same actor/request_id/payload returns the same IDs; changed payload409. Existing staged batches remain committable. Preflight never creates products, publishes or activates stock.
